trans.sense: Note: these translations are a guide only. For more precise translations, see individual words ending in -ic

glosses: Used to form adjectives from nouns with the meaning “of or pertaining to”.

raw_glosses: (chemistry) Used to denote certain chemical compounds in which a specified chemical element has a higher oxidation number than in the equivalent compound whose name ends in the suffix -ous. For example sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) has more oxygen atoms per molecule than sulphurous acid (H₂SO₃).
